items.headline: RBI may hike policy repo rate to 6.5% amid rising inflation concerns
items.summary: India's retail and wholesale inflation rose in August, prompting economists to predict the RBI will need to raise the repo rate from 5.25% to 6.5% to combat inflation and negative real interest rates, possibly as early as October or December 2026.

items.headline: Indian government reduces windfall taxes on petrol, diesel, and ATF exports
items.summary: The Indian government has reduced windfall taxes on exports of petrol, diesel, and aviation turbine fuel.

items.headline: PM Modi emphasizes predictable policy for semiconductor ecosystem; SEMICON India 2026 begins
items.summary: Prime Minister Modi chaired a Semiconductor Roundtable, reaffirming the government's commitment to a stable policy for India's semiconductor ecosystem. SEMICON India 2026, a three-day event, was inaugurated to build domestic manufacturing.

items.headline: India's power sector CO2 emissions show no growth in H1 2026 due to clean energy surge
items.summary: India's power sector CO2 emissions showed no growth in the first half of 2026, largely due to a surge in clean energy, with solar additions meeting 60% of the rise in electricity demand.

items.headline: Indian markets muted after US Fed hikes interest rates by 25 bps, signals further increases
items.summary: Indian markets faced a muted or negative start following the US Federal Reserve's decision to hike its main interest rate by 25 basis points, the first increase in three years, with indications of further hikes this year to tackle inflation.

items.headline: Elevated crude oil prices and West Asia geopolitical risks weigh on market sentiment
items.summary: Crude oil prices, hovering around $106-$108 a barrel, coupled with ongoing geopolitical risks in West Asia (including the US-Israeli war with Iran and concerns around the Strait of Hormuz), continue to weigh on market sentiment.

items.headline: US House passes bill for potential 100% tariffs on nations buying Russian oil
items.summary: The US House of Representatives passed legislation authorizing potential tariffs of up to 100% on India and other nations that purchase oil and gas from Russia.

items.headline: Indian Rupee depreciates, briefly breaches 96 against USD before recovery
items.summary: The Indian Rupee depreciated, briefly breaching the 96 mark against the US dollar in early trade before recovering some losses, possibly due to suspected RBI intervention.

items.headline: Tempsens Instruments India to announce Q1 results today
items.summary: Tempsens Instruments India is scheduled to announce its first-quarter results today.

items.headline: Skyways Air Services Ltd. to release quarterly results and declare interim dividend
items.summary: Skyways Air Services Ltd. will release its quarterly results and declare an interim dividend today.

items.headline: Indian equity benchmarks trade marginally higher after opening in red
items.summary: After opening in the red, Indian equity benchmarks, Sensex and Nifty, traded marginally higher in early morning trade today.

items.headline: Banking, Financial, and FMCG stocks lead rebound; Metal, Auto, Media also higher
items.summary: Yesterday, banking, financial, and FMCG stocks supported a rebound in the Nifty and Sensex, helping them snap a two-session losing streak. Nifty FMCG rose by 1.63% and Nifty PSU Bank gained 1.44%, while metal, auto, and media stocks also closed higher.

items.headline: IT and pharma stocks see profit-taking; IT susceptible to higher US interest rates
items.summary: IT and pharma stocks saw profit-taking after their recent strong performance. IT stocks, in particular, may remain susceptible to higher US interest rates.

items.headline: Oil companies to react to crude prices and windfall tax cut
items.summary: Oil companies are expected to react to changes in crude prices and the government's windfall tax cut.

items.headline: Semiconductor and electronics manufacturing sectors in focus with SEMICON India 2026
items.summary: The semiconductor and electronics manufacturing sectors are in focus today due to the inauguration of SEMICON India 2026.

items.headline: NSE IPO worth ₹22,561.57 crore opens today, expected to absorb market liquidity
items.summary: The initial public offering (IPO) of the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE), valued at ₹22,561.57 crore, opens for subscription today, September 17, and will remain open until September 21. This pure offer for sale, one of the country's largest public issues this year, is expected to absorb liquidity from the secondary market.

items.headline: Highway Infrastructure secures ₹220.66 crore order from UP Expressways Industrial Development Authority
items.summary: Highway Infrastructure has secured an order worth ₹220.66 crore from the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority.

items.headline: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders signs MoU for Greenfield Shipbuilding Industrial Cluster
items.summary: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with National Shipbuilding & Heavy Industries Park Maharashtra to participate as an Anchor Shipyard in a proposed Greenfield Shipbuilding Industrial Cluster.

items.headline: Alembic Pharmaceuticals receives US FDA EIR for Vadodara bioequivalence facility
items.summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals received an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR) from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA), closing the inspection of its bioequivalence facility in Vadodara, Gujarat.

items.headline: M&A volumes double since FY17; new bill to simplify processes and CCI reforms
items.summary: Mergers and acquisitions (M&As) continue to be a significant growth strategy for Indian companies, with annual deal volumes more than doubling since fiscal 2017. The Corporate Laws (Amendment) Bill, 2026, aims to simplify and accelerate M&A processes.

items.headline: Highway Infrastructure, GR Infraprojects, Mazagon Dock, Alembic Pharma, Groww in focus due to recent orders, deals, regulatory updates
items.summary: Highway Infrastructure, G R Infraprojects, Mazagon Dock, Alembic Pharma, and Groww are being closely watched today due to recent orders, deals, and regulatory updates.

items.headline: Tempsens Instruments India in focus ahead of Q1 results
items.summary: Tempsens Instruments India is also being watched today ahead of its first-quarter results announcement.

items.headline: Tata Group entities, CG Power, Kaynes Tech, Dixon Tech, Syrma SGS, ASM Tech, MosChip Tech in spotlight for semiconductor push
items.summary: Companies like select Tata Group entities, CG Power, Kaynes Technology, Dixon Technologies, Syrma SGS Technology, ASM Technologies, and MosChip Technologies are in the spotlight given the inauguration of SEMICON India 2026 and the government's push for domestic semiconductor manufacturing.

items.headline: Monolithisch India, Shaily Engineering Plastics, Schneider Electric Infrastructure highlighted as growth stocks by Simply Wall St News
items.summary: Simply Wall St News highlighted Monolithisch India, Shaily Engineering Plastics, and Schneider Electric Infrastructure as Indian growth stocks to consider in September 2026, citing strong earnings growth expectations and solid balance sheets.

content.outlook: Indian markets closed on a positive note, with NIFTY and SENSEX showing modest gains driven by strong performances in Realty, Pharma, and Auto sectors. Domestic institutional investors provided significant support, absorbing foreign institutional selling. Traders should watch for continued sectoral rotation and DII activity as key drivers.
keyTakeaways: NIFTY and SENSEX closed positive, up 0.44% and 0.31% respectively.
Realty (+1.6%), Pharma (+1.3%), and Auto (+1.24%) sectors were the top performers.
Nifty Bank and Nifty IT indices ended marginally in negative territory.
Market breadth was positive with 43 advances against 15 declines.
DIIs were net buyers (+3908.23cr) offsetting FII selling (-2032.61cr).
HDFCLIFE and SBILIFE were top gainers, while ONGC and BAJAJ-AUTO were top losers.
